title: Isolation and Culture of Human Islet Cells with Flow Cytometry Analysis
author: Sarah Popp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kwwcxfe
materials: See Guidelines, ' Before starting' and 'Safety Warnings'
See Guidelines, ' Before starting' and 'Safety Warnings'

steps.title: Initial Islet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the human islets to prepare them for dissociation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge human islets at 300g for 2 min at 23°C.
Pour off the supernatant.
Resuspend in ~25 ml PBS/3 mM EDTA.
Centrifuge at 300g.

steps.title: Islet Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Distribute islets into tubes for processing.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the islets in PBS/3 mM EDTA.
Transfer islets to 15ml tubes at a density of 2000 islet equivalents (IEQ) per tube.
Centrifuge at 300g and carefully remove the supernatant.
Gently resuspend each pellet in 1ml pre-thawed Accutase.
Place tubes in 37°C waterbath for 10 mins, gently knocking the pellet to resuspend the islets at the 4 min and 8 min marks.
Dissociate the islets by pipetting up and down 10-15 times using a 1 ml single channel pipette.

steps.title: Termination and Cell Recovery
steps.instruction: Stop the enzymatic reaction and prepare the cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 ml culture medium to each tube to terminate the Accutase reaction.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300g.
Discard the supernatant and pool the cells into a single 15 ml tube.
Determine cell density using a hemocytometer and adjust to 100,000 - 325,000 cells/ml.

steps.title: Plating and Culture
steps.instruction: Seed the islet cells into culture plates and apply treatments.

substeps.instruction: Transfer islet cells to culture plate at 20,000 - 65,000 cells (in 200 μl) per well.
Centrifuge at 300g and remove the supernatant by flicking.
Culture islet cells with heparin or heparan sulfate mimetics (e.g. PI-88) at a final concentration of 50 μg/ml in 200 μl/well, or in medium for control cells.

steps.title: Viability Analysis via Newport Green/7AAD
steps.instruction: Determine cell viability on day 0 and 2 days after culture using Newport Green and 7AAD staining.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge culture plate at 300g for 3 min and remove culture supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 10 μM Newport Green (100 μl/well) and incubate at 37°C for 1 hr.
Add 100 μl culture medium, centrifuge at 300g, and remove culture supernatant.
Resuspend in 10 μg/ml 7AAD (100 μl/well) and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Add 100 μl PBS, centrifuge at 300g, remove culture supernatant, and resuspend in 100 μl PBS.
Analyze via flow cytometry using CellQuest™ Pro software (version 6.0; BD Biosciences).
Identify viable beta cells as Newport Green+ve 7AAD-ve and dead/damaged beta cells as Newport Green+ve 7AAD+ve (Excitation/emission: Newport Green 503 nm/535 nm; 7AAD 546 nm/647 nm).

steps.title: Viability Analysis via SYTOX Green
steps.instruction: Monitor hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death using SYTOX Green staining.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge culture plate at 300g for 3 min and remove culture supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μl of 30% H2O2 or culture medium for 5 min.
Add 100 μl culture medium and centrifuge at 300g for 3 min.
Remove culture supernatant and resuspend cells in 31.25 nM SYTOX Green (1/160,000 dilution of stock), 100 μl/well.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Add 100 μl PBS, centrifuge at 300g for 3 min, remove culture supernatant, and resuspend in 100 μl PBS.
Analyze via flow cytometry using CellQuest™ Pro software (version 6.0; BD Biosciences).
Identify dead/damaged islet cells as SYTOX Green+ve compared to unstained controls (Excitation/emission: 504 nm/523 nm).
